I'm going through the defects now: INV-005 has no criteria and is blocking, and QUS-006 looks ambiguous because the receipt format and contents aren't specified. I'm also weighing whether INV-003 is estimable, since the format, contents, period, and channel are all missing, and I'm not confident about that yet. For DOR-002, I doubt the download period is a business rule limit.

I'm checking BM-003 next: the receipt shows account and amount, and the HU doesn't say how that data is masked, so I'm treating it as a blocking defect. BM-007 looks like a major defect because the download depends on the network and the error case isn't defined. I don't think BM-009 applies, since no new personal data is collected. I'm leaving QUS-006 unflagged, since INV-003 already covers the receipt contents. I'm deciding to return the HU, and I'll look up the scale and references before I register it.
